title: Functional Test Designer v2.6.0 -> Assertiva 1.1.0 dogfood feedback
authority: Same agent built the FTD release, ran Assertiva, wrote the assessment and this intake: self-review plus tool evidence, not an independent qualification. Every engine behaviour listed was re-run on a synthetic reproducer with the published 1.1.0.

findings.summary: a test file in a non-package tests/ directory becomes `python -m unittest --failfast tests.test_x`; discovery's sys.path entry is lost, a sibling-helper import fails, the pre-run fails and no mutant runs
findings.suggested_fix: keep discovery semantics for files in a non-package discovery directory (discover -s DIR -p FILE, refusing ambiguous patterns) or prepend DIR to the subprocess PYTHONPATH; package layouts unchanged
acceptance: the reproducer's file selection runs exactly its 2 tests and evaluates mutants

findings.summary: the budget applies to a whole target; no function, line-range or changed-lines selection exists, so medium safety modules cannot be measured
findings.suggested_fix: --mutate FILE::QUALNAME, --mutate FILE:A-B and --mutate-changed-since REV implemented with Cosmic Ray's line filter between init and the budget check; the budget counts only mutants left to run; report planned_total, selected, evaluated and scope; a targeted score is never presented as the module's
acceptance: a region selection runs under the budget and reports both populations
IDEA-02's full-denominator rule kept for whole-module claims

findings.summary: a helper double whose plain base is imported from another project test module, with an API method named test_*, is reported although the same audit's native run did not collect it
findings.suggested_fix: resolve project-local imports when reading bases (bounded depth) and reconcile with the executed test ids: absent and without a TestCase ancestor is not a test class
acceptance: no UNKNOWN entry for the reproducer's double after --execute
an imported TestCase subclass the runner skips is still reported

findings.summary: two derived entries with the same signature are both written; a derived entry and the agent entry about the same finding are not linked; the dry run plans CREATE twice for one AFB id while the real import skips the second

observed.import: CREATE once, SKIP_ALREADY_IMPORTED once; re-import skips all 8

findings.suggested_fix: dedup derived entries by signature at write time; relates_to on derived entries; the dry run applies the import's idempotence
acceptance: the run's file holds each issue once, with explicit links
dry run and import print the same plan
true second reports still add sightings

findings.summary: external runs on a stack the engine executed are recorded as UNSUPPORTED/capability_gap; they covered another dependency profile, another OS, and a mutation the engine could not complete
findings.suggested_fix: derive 'unsupported' only when no adapter was recognized for that purpose; otherwise record an external complement linked to its reason (profile, platform, engine failure)
acceptance: no UNSUPPORTED entry for an executed stack
an external mutation after MUTATION_RUN_NOT_COMPLETED links to that finding

findings.summary: the reported Skill/engine drift was an agent error (CRLF from core.autocrlf; files identical to v1.1.0 ignoring CR). Residual: no declared Skill version to compare with the engine, and no Portfolio state to withdraw a disproved entry
findings.suggested_fix: a version field in SKILL.md frontmatter and an offline check that compares declared versions; Portfolio WITHDRAWN and DUPLICATE_OF states with evidence
acceptance: a mismatch is reported from declared versions
a withdrawn entry stops counting as open

findings.summary: 4 of 5 receipts UNVERIFIED for contract-correct reasons (plain text logs, other revision); the attach summary shows counts but not each receipt's link and reason
findings.suggested_fix: print link and blocking reason per receipt when attaching; ADAPTIVE_TOOLS.md: write JUnit/CTRF for external test runs and import Cosmic Ray results with --mutation-report
acceptance: attaching the same assessment shows the four reasons without opening audit.json

not_counted: CI_PYTEST_NOT_OBSERVED on stdlib-unittest reproducers without CI (possibly AXF-VN-05); not investigated
